svg.title: A finite angular menu normally restricts the reader and supplies upper, not lower, bounds on the continuous optimum. The following outer-action construction reverses that inclusion in a controlled way. Let w ∈R4 + be an unnormalized label weight vector. Write Vt(w) for minimum expected terminal-error mass with t trials remaining. Thus V0(w) = min(wX+ + wY +, wX−+ wY −). Every fixed continuation has a four-component loss vector in [0, 1]4; Vt is their infimum. It is positively homogeneous, concave, and on the unit simplex is 1/2-Lipschitz in l1 distance. For normalized w, the last statement follows because any loss vector has range at most one and P h(wh −w′ h) = 0. For a real pair a = (c, s) define the nominal kernels
